title: Cobram Estate Olive Oil 2L $29.99 (Was $37) @ ALDI
body:
Deal: Cobram Estate Olive Oil 2L $29.99 (Was $37) @ ALDI

[Harsh Deep] i know, but nowadays 750ml goes for $25 full price and $12.5 when on special at half price.
[ihbh] The Aldi homebrand one is 3L for $40, made by Cobram.
[jv] made by Cobram.
Boundary Bend make it…
Different blend to Cobram.
[ihbh] Cobram Estate Olives Limited (ASX: CBO) was formerly known as "Boundary Bend". Cobram also happens to be one of the brands they own.
[jv] That doesn't mean that the Cobram oil is the same as the Aldi one, and if you tried them both, you'd know …
[ihbh] @jv: Yes, I've tried both and also Red Island, which is also a Cobram brand and they all taste slightly different. They own and source from many orchards (soil, climate, etc., differences) and there are many trees in each orchard.
[MonkDog] @jv: Hey hey hey now jv!
Just because you bought a $8 multi-tool from Aldi years ago, that doesn't mean it's the same as a Leatherman, and if you tried them both, you'd know …

doesn't mean it's the same as a Leatherman
